ling_spam.criteria_inversion: detailed criteria is 1.56 points worse than plain

modern_mail.criteria_inversion: urgency_authority is 0.32 points worse than bare category; names-only is 1.58 points better

ruling.why: On Ling-Spam, TypeSafe plain 98.57% versus email-dataset-trained TF-IDF 72.98%; on recent phishing TypeSafe 91.3% phishing share versus TF-IDF 70.3%; on modern mail category accuracy 97.00% versus TF-IDF 72.51%.
ruling.why_criteria: Structured/detail criteria are worse than the bare/category question on Ling-Spam and modern mail. More prompt specification was not monotonically helpful.
ruling.failure_recovered: The first --report/ood_test run stopped after Ling-Spam because nazario phishing mailboxes were absent. fetch_nazario.sh fixed the missing prerequisite; the complete report then exited 0.
ruling.no_claim: These are exploratory single-run results on the repository's saved TypeSafe answers and one 633-request modern run; they do not establish universal spam-filter accuracy.
